title: Bill 87 extending temporary structure permits to five years
summary: Bill 87 would let temporary structures allowed under an emergency proclamation remain in place for up to five years. At its July 19, 2024 meeting, the council postponed County Communication 24-23, a proposed amendment to Bill 87, until it takes up the bill itself. One testifier said Bills 87, 105 and 110 would help provide temporary housing.

fromCommunityMeetings.who: Maui County Director of Public Works
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: We do have a process for temporary structures, temporary dwellings.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Public Works said early in the recovery that the county already had a process for temporary dwellings on fire-affected lots and was refining those rules for the period between debris cleanup and rebuilding.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: December 13, 2023

fromCommunityMeetings.who: Maui County Director of Environmental Management
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: Once that's deemed up and running, you have to certify that your sewer lateral is not damaged. If it is damaged, then you would need to repair that, and then you can tie into our sewer line once we clear the use of that sewer line in the roadway.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Environmental Management explained the wastewater requirement for owners who want temporary structures on their Lahaina lots: the sewer line to the home must be certified undamaged before connecting.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: December 13, 2023
